titleEn: Royal decrees No. 0819/1302 on the establishment of Battambang Appeal Court

articles.en: - The Battambang Regional Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor’s Office attached to the Battambang Regional Court of Appeal shall receive and decide appeals against the decisions of the First Instance Court of Kampong Chhnang Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Pursat Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Battambang Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Pailin Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Banteay Meanchey Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Oddar Meanchey Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, and the First Instance Court of Siem Reap Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, or cases remitted by the Supreme Court.
- All provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

- The Supreme Council of the Magistracy and Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
[Illegible in source: seal and registration number]
Norodom Sihamoni; at the Royal Palace, 07 August 2019; certified true copy of the original; Minister in charge of the Council of Ministers, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Bin Chhin.
